item.title: Quentin Tarantino Offers New Details On His Original ‘Inglourious Basterds’ Miniseries & The Black Soldiers Storyline He Cut
item.description: For all his reputation as an indulgent filmmaker who rarely knows when to stop, Quentin Tarantino has occasionally demonstrated a surprising willingness to kill his darlings. And few projects required more ruthless self-editing than “ Inglourious Basterds ,” his 2009 World War II revenge epic, which spent years threatening to become something far bigger, stranger, and more unwieldy than the film that eventually reached theaters. At one point, Tarantino had so many characters, subplots, and elaborate detours that a conventional feature seemed almost impossible.
